description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.001 USDC per call via x402] Catches typos in identifiers before they go on an invoice, a payment or an order: IBAN (country length + mod-97), US ABA routing number (3-7-1 checksum), GTIN/EAN/UPC barcodes, ISBN-10/13, VIN (check digit), US NPI, EIN (format and IRS prefix), or any Luhn number. type auto guesses from the shape. Up to 500 per call. A valid checksum means well-formed, not that the account or product exists.
name: id_check
title: Validate identifiers by their check digits (IBAN, routing number, barcode, ISBN, VIN, NPI, EIN)
